 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Chandrasekhar Sharma, Advocate
 For the Informant : Mr. Vijay Anand, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Pramod Kumar Pandey, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sourendra Pandey
 Oral Order

7 09-05-2025 Heard Mr. Chandrasekhar Sharma, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner, Mr.
Vijay Anand, the learned counsel for the Informant and Mr. Pramod Kumar Pandey, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Magadh Medical P.S. Case No. 268 of 2023,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is ready to furnish the demand of Rs. 10 lakhs at the time of furnishing the bail bond and rest of Rs. 35 lakhs in installments within one year.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.86792 of 2024(7) dt.09-05-2025 4.

The learned counsel for the informant does not dispute such offer and is ready to accept the same and he also states that the right of the informant to claim, any further amount, through a proceedings under money suit, shall not come in his way in view of the present order.

5. In view of the aforesaid, let the petitioner, above named, be released on provisional bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court of learned A.C.J.M.- II, Gaya, in connection with Magadh Medical P.S. Case Satya Prakash @ Bittu vs The State Of Bihar on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166938042/
1 No. 268 of 2023, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) The petitioner shall deposit the rest of the admitted dues i.e., Rs. 35 lakhs within one year from the date of his release.
(ii) The said amount shall be furnished by the petitioner by way of demand draft in the name of the informant.
(iii) If the informant ultimately is found to be not entitled for the said amount, the same shall be refunded to the petitioner after the completion of the trial of the said case.
(iv) The petitioner shall deposit his passport, if any, with the learned trial Court or he shall file an affidavit to the effect that he does not hold a passport.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.86792 of 2024(7) dt.09-05-2025 (v) One of the bailors of the petitioner shall be his close relative and the other shall be local resident.
